text:
The image deployed, but staging is unhealthy. `api:7f3c2e1` built, pushed, and rolled out, then `/healthz` was still returning 503 when the 60s healthcheck timed out.

I haven't diagnosed it yet. It could be slow startup that needs more time, or the new pods could be failing, for example crash-looping, failing readiness, or missing config. `kubectl -n staging rollout status deployment/api` and the new pods' logs will show which. If the fix itself is at fault, `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api` restores the previous image.
